test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

I asked my mother where she kept the grocery.

options.text: I said to my mother, "Where have you kept the grocery?"
I said to my mother, "Where do you keep the grocery?"
I said to my mother, "Where does she keeps the grocery?"
I said to my mother, "Where she keeps the grocery?"

solution:
The correct answer is '**I said to my mother, "Where do you keep the grocery?**""

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech and we need to convert it to direct speech.
 
• When we change an indirect speech to direct speech, we use the following rules - 
 
 
• The reporting verb asked is changed to said to. 
 
• The conjunction that is replaced with inverted commas ("...") to show the direct speech. 
 
• A comma (,) is added before the direct speech part. 
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in *capital letter. *
 
• The **past tense** kept is changed to its present tense form keep. 
 
• The pronoun she is changed from second person to first person you. 
 
• Since, the reported speech is a question, the verb do is added.
 
 
 
• So, by following the above rules, we get the direct speech as - I said to my mother, "Where do you keep the grocery?"
 
• Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.
